skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the economic functions of urban areas, analyze urban issues such as land use, urban transportation, income distribution, and crime from an economic perspective, and apply economic tools to analyze urban development and decision-making.
Apply microeconomic theories in urban contexts.
Apply macroeconomic theories in urban contexts.
Analyze urban economic issues using economic models and theories.
Solve urban economic problems using economic theories and models.
Collaborate effectively in group settings to analyze and present urban economic issues.
Conduct independent research and present findings on urban economic topics.
Evaluate urban economic policies and their impacts critically.
Effectively present research findings and urban economic analyses.
